svg.title: gfazioli/mantine-scene at a glance
svg.desc: Composable decorative background for React + Mantine. Compose gradients, glow blobs, dot grids, mesh, noise, star fields, shooting stars, snow, rain, confetti, parallax waves, radar pulses, beams and a 3D globe (cobe). Lazy mode + interactive mouse tracking.. 122 commits, 122 commits in the last year, 8 stars, 21 releases (latest 2.2.15), 2 contributors.
